doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source. held_fire.<dash|rmb|e|x|q|all>: {source, ours}: notes for the held-LMB rows (docs only: LMB is a held input everywhere, Hunter.trigger reads the key every frame and fire resumes the frame a slot's lock ends; --held-fire-resume-check). window.source: the footage evidence for the buffer window (DashFlow.BUFFER_S), shown in docs/heroes/dash_interactions.md.

x.source: Not in the data or footage for the crouch: Shift in Kitefall's 0.3s crouch goes at once (the Wirerun charges, or the air dash goes), the crouch waits and starts over where it took her, and she launches from there. The flight (rise, hang, drop) is the ult's own move: the source launches her up and she comes down at a spot she picks (card: 'launch into the air, then pick a location on the ground to forcefully land'; footage vireo.md 0353-0383: she hangs, then streaks down, no other move). Ours holds her over the ring's centre, invulnerable, so a dash there would carry her out of the ring.

glide.ours: a fresh press ends the dash that step and the glider opens the next, keeping the dash speed up to the handoff cap. Asserted in --airdash-glide-check.
